item.title: Jared Padalecki holiday film Guarding Stars arrives on Netflix
item.description: Netflix released Guarding Stars on November 18, 2026, with Jared Padalecki as an action star and Leighton Meester as the bodyguard hired to protect him.

item.title: Honda Takata airbag recall covers 810,592 vehicles in humid regions
item.description: American Honda is recalling 810,592 US vehicles to replace Takata airbag inflators that contain a moisture-absorbing desiccant.

item.title: Riemann hypothesis proof claim from Anthropic mathematician uses Lean
item.description: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he believes he found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis while working with Claude, and he released it as Lean files.

item.title: GTA 6 day one retail sales reach $3.79 billion, Rockstar estimates
item.description: Rockstar Games estimates Grand Theft Auto VI reached $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales worldwide through the end of November 19, 2026.

item.title: Yellowjackets season 4 opens final run on Paramount+ with Hivemind
item.description: Yellowjackets season 4 premiered on Paramount+ on November 20, 2026, opening the final season with the episode "Hivemind" for Paramount+ Premium subscribers.

item.title: JPMorgan Chase CFO Jeremy Barnum will hand the role to Bregje de Best
item.description: Bregje de Best, CFO of JPMorgan Chase's Commercial & Investment Bank, will succeed Jeremy Barnum as company CFO following first-quarter 2027 financial reporting.

item.title: Netflix releases The Altruists with Julia Garner and Anthony Boyle
item.description: Netflix has released all eight episodes of The Altruists, a limited series starring Anthony Boyle as Sam Bankman-Fried and Julia Garner as Caroline Ellison.

item.title: Gold price falls below $3,700, lowest level since September 2025
item.description: Gold traded just below $3,700 an ounce on Thursday after falling to its lowest level since September 2025, as Fed officials signaled more rate increases.

item.title: Boardmasters 2027 lineup names Chase & Status, Disclosure, Wolf Alice
item.description: Chase & Status, Disclosure and Wolf Alice will headline Boardmasters 2027 in Cornwall, with Dutch DJ Chris Stassy booked as the first Thursday headliner.

item.title: Walmart raises full-year outlook as third-quarter revenue rises 5.2%
item.description: Walmart lifted its fiscal 2027 sales and earnings forecasts after third-quarter revenue rose 5.2% to $188.8 billion and global e-commerce sales grew 17%.

item.title: GTA 6 voice actors named in Rockstar credits led by Rourke and Perez
item.description: Rockstar's official Grand Theft Auto VI credits name Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval and Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos, alongside a wider main cast.

item.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50 in Nasdaq debut after $83 IPO price
item.description: Anthropic shares opened at $111.50 on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19, 34% above the $83 price set for its 980 million share offering.

item.title: Twitch Hosting is coming back and Clips will grow to five minutes
item.description: Twitch said at TwitchCon San Diego 2026 that a new version of Hosting will begin testing later this year and that it is working to extend Clips to five minutes.

item.title: England drought could last into 2027 without 120% of average rainfall
